What the records look like

Five templates for the records we hand over. They show the structure and the acceptance questions; they contain no project data. Project records are shared with the owner, and with others only with the owner's permission.

Download all five as PDFHow the turnover package is structured
Template · not a project record

1. Factory acceptance test record

One sheet per prefabricated assembly (skid, rack manifold or CDU), completed at the factory before release. Gate 1 of commissioning.

3. System boundary diagram

Drawn for each project, so every party can see where its responsibility starts and stops. The six boundaries follow the thermal path. This template numbers them in the direction heat travels, chip outward; the thermal path page and the simulator number them facility inward, so boundary 1 here is boundary 6 there.

1Cold plate and chipCold-plate maker, server OEMRecord owner: ______
2Hoses, crimps and fittingsHose assembler, rack integratorRecord owner: ______
3Rack manifold and quick disconnectsRack integrator, QD supplierRecord owner: ______
4CDU and secondary loopCDU maker, integratorRecord owner: ______
5Facility water interfaceFacility mechanical contractorRecord owner: ______
6Heat rejection and reuseHeat-rejection vendor or heat buyerRecord owner: ______
